So you are seeing a problem with oauth. As stated in https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/153.0.2esr/releasenotes/, 153.0.2 should have some config settings updated for yahoo.

Open your email Config Editor with Settings > Config Editor.

  • Is mailnews.oauth.usePrivateBrowser set it to true?
  • Is mailnews.oauth.useSchemeRedirect set it to false?

If any of these values do not match, please set them per above, and restart Thunderbird.

What are your findings.

I fail to what the issue is.

You install the addon, right click on the account name in the folder pane and select ImportExportToolsNG from the menu You select export the account from the sub menu that appears You acknowledge the warning and select a destination local file system folder to hold the exported mail. (I chose documents and a newcfolder was created there with the email account name as the folder name and the exported data included. Bringing that data back into Thunderbird is as simple as creating a local folder in Thunderbird and right clicking it and selecting the importExportToolsNG and importing a MBOX files and selecting all including the SDB structure. (last menu entry)

One of the issues will be that it may take days to actually get all you mail downloaded locally in a single IMAP account (yahoo limits both bandwidth use and total messages in a folder). Note that the appearance of a list of messages for a folder is not any sort of validation that there has been a download of an actual messages, only the list meta data..
